prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions frequently overestimated positive impact for neutral or negative changes, but underestimated large winning tests.
Sign-in hint changes (4 wins), home wait_info changes (5 wins), and finish new_screen changes (2 wins) can be helpful, though many tests showed no clear effect.
Sign-in reorder changes proved consistently harmful across agreeing tests.
Choose_path copy, choose_path layout, choose_path redesign, finish new_flow, home new_flow, and adoption new_flow changes can be helpful (each having 1 winning test), though other tests showed no clear effect or negative impact.
Finish copy, home notification, and adoption hint changes showed no clear effect across agreeing tests with no wins.
Evidence remains thin or inconsistent for adoption redesign and single-test categories.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Tray & Control Mastery Screen: Adds a dedicated final onboarding screen before entering the desktop explaining keyboard hotkeys, system tray minimizing, and pet commands. (why: 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet, and finish new_screen changes have 2 past wins.)
1: [home, new_flow] Desktop Render Background Prep Activity Stream Flow: Rebuilds the waiting screen during pet rendering with an interactive background preparation activity stream featuring live status updates. (why: Home wait time averages 2336s, and home wait_info and new_flow changes have proven effective in past winning tests.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Pet Account Recovery Reassurance Callout: Displays a prominent hint on the sign-in screen reassuring existing users that signing in restores previous pets without account resets. (why: 8 support emails (most reported issue) complained about pets missing or reset after signing in, and sign_in hint changes have 4 past wins.)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Spawn & System Tray Status Monitor: Enhances the rendering waiting screen with diagnostic status steps indicating graphics initialization and system tray icon attachment. (why: 3 support emails reported pet not showing on desktop or app failing to open, and home wait_info changes have 5 past wins.)
4: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Visibility & Taskbar Quick Reference Guide Screen: Adds an onboarding summary screen at the end demonstrating how to reveal the pet if hidden behind full-screen applications. (why: Support emails report users struggling to locate pets on desktop or understanding how to bring pets back to focus.)
5: [adoption, layout] Pet Photo Selection Two-Column Layout: Updates the photo upload screen layout to a two-column format presenting upload guidelines directly beside the photo picker. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 70.5% and support emails highlight custom pet photo generation errors.)
6: [choose_path, hint] Path Selection Express vs Custom Guidance Hint: Adds a hint on the choose path screen clarifying that preset pets can still be customized later in application settings. (why: Choose_path mean duration is 514s; clarifying that path selection is not permanent reduces user hesitance.)
7: [finish, copy] Home Intro Desktop Controls & Shortcut Copy: Updates home intro welcome text to explicitly list mouse interaction shortcuts and context menu commands. (why: Multiple support tickets asked how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after completing setup.)
